import 'dart:async';

import 'package:adele_ui/owning_backend_bridge.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:stream_fixture/contract.dart';

Widget buildView() => StreamProbe();
bool readOnData = false;
Widget buildReadingView() {
  readOnData = true;
  return StreamProbe();
}

class StreamProbe extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<StreamProbe> createState() => StreamProbeState();
}

class StreamProbeState extends State<StreamProbe> {
  final client = StreamServiceClient(
    OwningBackendRequestChannel(streamServiceId),
  );
  String text = 'idle';
  dynamic subscription;
  bool disposed = false;

  void start() {
    subscription = client
        .watch('captured')
        .listen(
          (StreamEntry entry) {
            setState(() {
              text = '${entry.sequence}:${entry.text}';
            });
            if (readOnData) read();
          },
          onError: (Object error) {
            setState(() {
              text = 'error:$error';
            });
          },
          onDone: () {
            setState(() {
              text = '$text:done';
            });
          },
        );
  }

  void read() {
    client.read('captured').then((StreamEntry entry) {
      setState(() {
        text = '${entry.sequence}:${entry.text}';
      });
    });
  }

  void readSettled() async {
    final result = await settleOwningBackendOperation(client.read('captured'));
    if (disposed) return;
    if (result[0] == true) {
      final StreamEntry entry = result[1];
      setState(() { text = 'settled:${entry.sequence}:${entry.text}'; });
    } else {
      setState(() { text = 'settled:unavailable'; });
    }
  }

  void startNullData() {
    // The pin's SDK declaration rejects literal Null for nullable callbacks.
    // Dynamic values exercise actual eval nulls without replacing that library.
    dynamic callback = null;
    subscription = client
        .watch('captured')
        .listen(
          callback,
          onError: callback,
          onDone: () {
            setState(() {
              text = 'null-data:done';
            });
          },
        );
  }

  void startNullErrorAndDone() {
    dynamic callback = null;
    subscription = client
        .watch('captured')
        .listen(
          (StreamEntry entry) {
            setState(() {
              text = '${entry.sequence}:${entry.text}';
            });
          },
          onError: callback,
          onDone: callback,
        );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    disposed = true;
    if (subscription != null) subscription.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(text),
      TextButton(onPressed: start, child: Text('Listen')),
      TextButton(onPressed: read, child: Text('Read')),
      TextButton(onPressed: readSettled, child: Text('Read settled')),
      TextButton(onPressed: startNullData, child: Text('Null Data')),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: startNullErrorAndDone,
        child: Text('Null Error And Done'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          subscription.pause();
        },
        child: Text('Pause'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          subscription.resume();
        },
        child: Text('Resume'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          subscription.cancel();
        },
        child: Text('Cancel'),
      ),
    ],
  );
}
